newsitem.title: USA: ShopKo Stores sees softer sales trends.
newsitem.headline: ShopKo Stores sees softer sales trends.

text.p: ShopKo Stores Inc said on Thursday that October sales trends are expected to soften as it reduces promotional activity and places greater focus on the holiday selling season.
ShopKo said consolidated sales for the five weeks ended October 5 increased 28.0 percent from a year earlier, to $215.8 million from $168.6 million.
Consolidated comparable sales for September increased 19.6 percent, and retail comparable store sales increased 10.3 percent, it said.
ShopKo in September agreed to combine with Phar-Mor Inc to form a new holding company called Cabot Noble Inc. The deal is expected to be completed in December.
